_comment: FLUX.1-dev caps-based inline sampling. FLUX conditioning is MULTI-tensor, so caps.positive is a CACHE-ENTRY-SHAPED safetensors carrying TWO keys: 't5_embed' [1,LT,4096] (LT<=512, T5-XXL hidden; trainer zero-pads to 512) + 'clip_pool' [768] (CLIP-L pooled). Produce via the flux cache precache / T5+CLIP encode. FLUX.1-dev is guidance-DISTILLED (single forward, no CFG uncond): caps.negative is REQUIRED by the parser but UNUSED, and 'cfg' maps to the distillation guidance scalar (3.5 typical). width/height = the binary's native 512px preview (enforce_min_image_size false because <1024).
